verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs say a little about its credit model: credits can be topped up without changing plans, and MCP-driven builds run on the user's Claude/ChatGPT subscription rather than Floot credits. The pack has no per-action credit costs and no breakdown of plan inclusions. Missing for 10: a per-action credit or token consumption table, documentation of what each plan includes, a usage or credit-balance dashboard, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can understand what credits or tokens each action consumes and what my plan includes

citations.quote: you no longer have to upgrade or downgrade your plan — just add credits whenever you need them.
It runs on your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), not Floot credits.
You can download a full SQL dump of your database at any time, on any plan
